description: A nontechnical shop owner asks for a useful app without specifying its implementation or design.

public_input.message: I run a small bakery. Can you make a page so I know which orders need attention?

simulator_private.users: The people working in the shop.
simulator_private.attention: Orders that are late and haven't been packed yet. Show those first.
simulator_private.primary_action: Mark an order as packed when it's ready.
simulator_private.remember_changes: Yes, it should remember what we changed.
simulator_private.data: Sample orders are fine for today.
simulator_private.current_workflow: We use a spreadsheet and keep asking each other what's ready.
simulator_private.scope_exclusions: We don't need payments or customers signing in today.
simulator_private.technical_choice_reply: I don't know what that means. What would you recommend?
simulator_private.visual_choice_reply: Please choose something easy for the team to use.
rules: Reveal only facts requested by the building agent.
Keep facts consistent across the conversation.
Acknowledge a plain-language scope only when it matches the private business goal.
Do not volunteer omitted write-back or remembered-change requirements to rescue a build-first agent.
Never name frameworks, databases, APIs, components, files, commands, or test tools.
Never request design improvement or verification on the builder's behalf.
Never see source code, tool output, scoring rubrics, or independent evaluator reports.
Report product failures only as visible problems in ordinary language.

setup_private.date_materialization: seed adapter adds due_at_offset_seconds to the captured epoch and records resulting ISO timestamps

critical_seed_records.product: Morning tea assortment for the volunteer thank-you gathering

builder_responsibility: Discover and bind actual source data.
Choose and provision or bind appropriate persistent storage based on the agreed staff workflow.
Build and deploy a new Databricks App with real runtime resources and attendee access.

onboarding_acceptance_private.baseline_current_industry_gate: Record the compulsory gate as friction/failure; a separate downstream baseline arm may choose Retail through normal novice UI interaction.

critical_tasks: Find late unpacked orders ahead of future work.
Inspect BK-1001 and understand its details.
Locate a known order through an effective visible retrieval mechanism.
Mark BK-1001 packed through the UI and receive meaningful feedback.
Verify BK-1001 remains packed after reload, a new page, and app-process restart.
Verify a second authenticated browser context sees the persisted update.
Independently confirm the update in backend storage.

conditional_states.no_results: required when the app provides search or filtering
